"Do they really send INTSEC to check on your loyalty?"
"No, I'm really interested in your perspective on the man."
"It's not my place to judge."
"He's practical. Knows how to keep his feet on the deck."
"He should be bolder. The Hegemony has great power, he should use it!"
"I think he's in over his head. Maybe it's his background, maybe his character."
"Honestly, I could do a better job as High Hegemon."
"Someone like Orcus Rao should be in charge. He knows when to bend the rules."
"You don't think sacrifices are ever necessary?"
"What's a war hero doing in this backwater outpost?"

"What in the worlds are you talking about?"
"Yes, I think a medal would be in order."
"Oh, I remember now."
"That must have been a different $playerName."
"When did I ever lie to the Hegemony?" (feign innocence)
"Is this about that fleet looking for Gargoyle after I left Tse Franchise Station?"
Withhold comment
"Well. Sorry."
"Don't blame them too much, I can be pretty convincing when I want to be."
Let him get to his point, whatever it is
"That'd be the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud."
"Yes?"
"I met your... niece. Grandniece? Neriene Rao. On Eventide."
"And easily. Those brutes did not realize that I had studied the blade."
"It was a shame to lose... for I have studied the blade."
"No. I've had worse."
"No. I've had worse." (lie)
"Just my pride, perhaps. But don't worry, it's more than recovered."
"What matters is I stood to their insults and fought. My honor is intact."
"They chose to make me their enemy long before that night."
"I simply defended my honor against some thugs."
"Someone had to put those aristocratic bullies in their place."
"I did not go to House Rao to start a brawl, sir."
"Did I? It was a cowardly exit."
"It was looked upon poorly, but I had to think of Neriene."
"It's a stupid tradition anyway. Who fights with oversized knives in this age?"
"The Strategic Assembly of the Hegemony? That could be inconvenient."
"I'm not worried about the Strategic Assembly."
"I'll keep that in mind."
"What's a 'pawn'?"
"I'll watch my back."
"I'll be sure to decline the next invitation to House Rao's seasonal ball."
"'Perhaps'? I'm counting on it!"
"Hadi, naturally. I'm a little old-school that way."
"Andreas, of course. The flexibility is paramount."
"The Jung-Sook, actually. I believe it's been unfairly discounted."
"The duel."
"Then she spoke to you... about me?"
"Not my concern."
"Bad words?"
"She spoke to you about... that evening?"
"A merc on the Askonia fringe told me to visit Ragnar. I assume that means you."
"I think they were working for you. And under orders not to say so."
"What? The Hegemony regularly employs mercenaries."
"If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it."
"Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in."
"Clearly you don't take this very seriously."
"Right. I don't have time for this."
"Because you'll pay me well, and on time. You were a freelancer, you know the life."
"They're mutineers. They undermine the restoration of the Domain, the Hegemony's purpose."
"They're brutal oppressors, enemies of freedom and life. It's a just cause.
"They're systematically killing the Faithful, they closed the Shrine of Volturn. My duty is to resist."
"Because they're falling apart. They're going to lose and I like being on the winning side."
"He... recruited me into his scheme and one thing led to another. I'm not really sure."
"He paid me in credits and hardware for some jobs. I have no loyalty to him."
"I gained his trust in order to sabotage and betray him. To help you, the Hegemony."
"To bring the Diktat down from the inside. Are you going to help or not?"
"I figure I could take over the Sindrian Diktat if I played this right."
"I'm not answering that."
"I think you might have work for me."
"And what do you have in mind?"
"Who is Dolos?"
"Look, I just take Diktat money. I'm a merc. Like you were."
"I take it that's a 'no', then."
"I just take Diktat money. I'm a mercenary. Like you were."
"You're a worm compared to the genius of Dolos Macario!"
"I take it that's a 'no'."
"My membership in the Persean League is my business."
"Reynard is insufferable, but I could not get a better deal."
"Reynard is a great man. I follow him gladly."
"I don't need to explain myself to you."
"I have a plan to get out of it. You'll see."
"Is the Hegemony offering its protection against the League?"
"I'm sure I couldn't say."
"Horus Yaribay, you mean. And his desire for unification with the Hegemony."
"I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now."
"Speculate if you like, I have nothing to say."
"Hypothetically, I would require the consent of the third party before discussing anything."
"What'd you have in mind?"
"Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now."
"Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now."
"You disrespect the Faith with such comments."
"What sort of work do you need done?"
"You show little respect for your fellow officers of the Hegemony."
"What are these 'unique circumstances'? What is your goal?"
"Is this about taking down the Sindrian Diktat?"
"Why is it personal with Andrada?"
"I'm not so sure about this."
"So, ah. Do you still follow 'the Protocols'?"
